metadata.sampling: Three fresh processes per version per case; 100 operations per action; serial alternating before/after order, reversed in round 2. Median of per-round quantiles (round((n-1)*q)). CPU event and scene only; no rasterization or GPU presentation.
metadata.algorithm_method: Same 1m fixture, 3 fresh processes per version, 100 events per batch, two batches. Find: query text stays open while typing/backspacing in first paragraph. IME: begin composition before timing, alternate two candidate strings through native TextComposition events; type/backspace keys label the two candidate-update batches only. Committed text and marked display assertions run outside timing.
